# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified distribution file from [qrcode-generator 2.0.4](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licensed. The full license is included in [LICENSE](LICENSE), alongside the copyright notice in the source file. It is stored locally so user input is never sent to a QR service.
